# Petya Andromeda D10: D9 plus the families it still gets wrong, keeping what D9 learned

D9 is the group's D (39/54 new with 25 exact, 35/42 v22, 796/801 familiar). Its remaining errors are «в зал N» and a
lost recipient question (open-recipient), invented code lifetimes (code), cancel and permission wording. D10 continues
D9 with the D7–D9 recipe (lr 5e-7) on the familiar cases once, plus dialogues 41–60 of those four families and
dialogues 41–50 of the four families D9 learned (screen-only, exact-name, two-recipients, quote) so they are not
forgotten — 921 presentations. `Train Petya.app` runs `execution.json` into `~/.petya-train/andromeda-d10`.
Gate: replaces D9 only if not worse than D9 on any set.

## Result

| Set | D10 | D9 | D1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 54 generated held-out drafts | 46 (30 exact) | 39 (25 exact) | 24 |
| 30 v22 checks + 12 v22 drafts | 28 + 8 | 28 + 7 | 27 + 6 |
| 801 familiar cases | 797 | 796 | 787 |

Gained on held-out: all three open-recipient losses («в зале N», the recipient question), three code cases and both
permission cases; lost only code-17 («по нему же коду»). Better than D9 on new dialogues and v22 drafts, equal or
better elsewhere, so D10 is the group's D since 9 November 2026 (R1-A1-D10), published as `andromeda-d10`.
